# Privacy notice

The controller of your personal data is Hotel Lärchenwald AG, Via da Fex 7, 7514 Sils im Engadin/Segl, info@laerchenwald.example.

## Hosting

This website runs on Cloudflare. Each time you open a page, Cloudflare processes your IP address to deliver the page and block attacks. We use no cookies and no analytics tools.

## Contact form

When you write to us with the form, we send your name, your email address and your message by email to our front desk. We delete the message once your request is settled.

## Your rights

You can ask at any time which data we hold about you, and have it corrected or deleted. Write to info@laerchenwald.example.
